text:
Anya: quick note — this morning ~3% of leads showed as enriched in HubSpot but never hit the RR queue. visible gap between HS "enriched=true" and router pickup.
Marco: saw that too. looks like the enrichment vendor throttled us for ~10m and our webhook retries marked leads as enriched client-side before full payload arrived.
Pri (SDR): I had a few leads land with partial fields and the notes were missing. made follow-up awkward.
Lee (ops): root cause: enrichment webhook returns 202 with body `{partial:true}` during quota windows. HS workflow sets `enriched=true` on 202 which our router treats as ready. router expects `enrichment_complete=true` property. mismatch.
Anya: two action ideas: 1) change HS workflow to only set `enriched=true` when payload property `complete==true`; 2) router should tolerate partials by checking `enrichment_complete==true` before RR.
Marco: also propose a fallback weighting tweak: if enrichment vendor signals partial, route to a light-weight internal enrichment queue for small payloads (fast path) or mark for human review if crucial fields missing.
Pri (SDR): can we ensure SDRs see a clear timeline event: "partial enrichment - awaiting fields" so they don't prematurely contact leads?
Lee (ops): yes — add timeline event and show a small banner on owner card. I'll add a HubSpot workflow snippet:
```
IF webhook_response.complete == TRUE
  SET enrichment_complete = true
ELSE
  SET enrichment_complete = false
  SET enrichment_partial = true
```
Anya: runtime config change for RR: prefer owners with `capacity_score>0` and only pick if `enrichment_complete==true`. if `enrichment_partial==true` then route to `inbound-enrich-light` pool.
Marco: provisional canary: flip HS workflow and router guard behind flags for 5% traffic for 30m starting 08:30 PT. watch metrics: `enriched_but_unrouted_pct`, `partial_enrichment_rate`, `time_to_full_enrichment_p50`.
Pri (SDR): small UX ask 12 — when we route to `inbound-enrich-light`, include a note in HS "Routed to light enrichment queue - SDR hold" so it's clear.
automation-bot: Alert rule created: if enriched_but_unrouted_pct > 1% for 15m -> #marketing (rule id: RB-8201)
Lee (ops): ops test curl to simulate full vs partial: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/enrich/webhook -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"lead":"L-101","complete":false,"fields": ["email"]}'` returns 202/partial. Use that to validate workflows.
Marco: also adding a counterparty test: if vendor returns 429, mark `enrichment_retry_count` and backoff HS retries so we don't flood them during quota windows.
Anya: agree. add metric `enrichment_vendor_quota_backoff_p95` and surface it on marketing dashboard.
Lee (ops): will implement HS workflow guard, router enrichment_complete check, and add timeline event. will schedule canary and post results.
Marco: I'll open PR with router changes and unit tests. link in thread when ready.
Pri (SDR): thanks — appreciate the timeline event and banner. avoids extra pings. :thumbsup:
Anya: plan to reconvene after canary. if stable, we'll fold into the inbound playbook and update the SDR runbook with the new timeline message text.
Lee (ops): rolling out canary at 08:30 PT now. monitoring window 30m. tagging @Marco and @Anya.
